title: Alignment Is All You Need: Instruction-Free Training for General Audio-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.18132v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are typically built through a multi-stage pipeline consisting of cross-modal alignment, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and preference optimization. This pipeline assumes that adapting an LLM to a new modality requires extensive task-specific supervision. However, pretrained LLMs already possess strong reasoning and instruction-following abilities. As LLMs evolve rapidly, an important question remains: can we efficiently transfer these capabilities to a new modality with minimal intervention, and is alignment alone sufficient for building a multimodal model? We introduce an Instruction-Free Alignment-Only large audio-language model (LALM) that keeps both the audio encoder and the LLM fully frozen, learning only a lightweight projector. Borrowing insights from AzeroS [1], we train on (audio, response) pairs from Self-Generated Data Construction, where an LLM expands captions into free-form responses

translated_title: 对齐即一切：无需指令训练的通用音频-语言模型
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通常通过多阶段流水线构建，包括跨模态对齐、监督微调（SFT）和偏好优化。该流水线假设将大语言模型（LLM）适应到新模态需要大量特定于任务的监督。然而，预训练的LLM已经具备强大的推理和指令遵循能力。随着LLM的快速发展，一个关键问题仍然存在：我们能否以最小干预高效地将这些能力迁移到新模态，并且仅靠对齐是否足以构建多模态模型？我们引入了一种无需指令、仅对齐的大型音频-语言模型（LALM），该模型同时保持音频编码器和LLM完全冻结，仅学习一个轻量级投影器。借鉴AzeroS [1]的见解，我们使用自生成数据构建中的（音频，响应）对进行训练，其中LLM将标题扩展为自由形式的响应。
tldr: 本文提出一种仅需对齐训练、无需指令微调的音频-语言模型，通过冻结音频编码器和LLM并仅训练轻量投影器，利用自生成数据实现高效的多模态能力迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an instruction-free, alignment-only audio-language model that freezes both the audio encoder and LLM, training only a lightweight projector with self-generated data to efficiently transfer multimodal capabilities.
